description_en: Queries the details of a quality of service (QoS) policy instance
description_zh: 调用GetQosAttribute接口查询QoS策略实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag get-qos-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --qos-id qos-1iqifund3gcno50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetQosAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the QoS policy instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the QoS policy
parameters.name: qos_id

ErrorConfigSmartAGCount.description_en: The number of Smart Access Gateway instances with configuration errors
ErrorConfigSmartAGCount.description_zh: 配置异常的智能接入网关实例个数

QosCars.description_en: The rate limiting rules with configuration errors in the QoS policy
QosCars.description_zh: 配置异常的QoS策略限速规则信息

items.description_en: The list of rate limiting rules for the QoS policy instance
items.description_zh: QoS策略实例的限速规则信息列表

LimitType.description_en:
The rate limiting type. Valid values:

Absolute: by bandwidth value.
Percent: by percentage
LimitType.description_zh:
限速类型：

Absolute：按带宽值。
Percent：按百分比

PercentSourceType.description_en:
The bandwidth type when rate limiting is based on percentage. Valid values:

CcnBandwidth: Cloud Connect Network (CCN) bandwidth.
InternetUpBandwidth: Internet upstream bandwidth
PercentSourceType.description_zh:
按百分比限速时的带宽类型：

CcnBandwidth：云连接网带宽。
InternetUpBandwidth：公网上行带宽

Priority.description_en: The priority of the rate limiting rule. Valid values: 1 to 3. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh:
限速规则的优先级。

优先级支持设置1~3级，数值越小，优先级越高

QosCarDescription.description_en: The description of the rate limiting rule

QosCarId.description_en: The ID of the rate limiting rule

QosCarName.description_en: The name of the rate limiting rule

QosDescription.description_en: The description of the QoS policy instance

QosName.description_en: The name of the QoS policy instance

QosPolicies.description_en: The list of 5-tuple rules for the QoS policy instance
QosPolicies.description_zh: QoS策略实例的五元组规则信息列表

items.description_en: The 5-tuple rules of the QoS policy instance
items.description_zh: QoS策略实例的五元组规则信息

DestPortRange.description_en:
The destination port range. Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

Examples of the destination port range format:

1/200: indicates ports 1 to 200.
80/80: indicates port 80.
-1/-1: indicates that ports are not restricted
DestPortRange.description_zh:
目的端口范围。

取值范围：-1或1~65535。

目的端口范围格式示例：

1/200，表示端口范围1至200。
80/80，表示端口80。
-1/-1，表示不限制端口

EndTime.description_en: The expiration time of the 5-tuple rules. The time is displayed in Beijing time. Format: UTC+8
EndTime.description_zh:
五元组规则失效时间。

时间显示为北京时间，格式为：UTC时间+8小时

IpProtocol.description_en: The protocol type applied to the 5-tuple rules
IpProtocol.description_zh: 五元组规则应用的协议类型

Priority.description_en: The priority of the rate limiting rule to which the 5-tuple rules belong. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh:
五元组规则所属的限速规则的优先级。

数值越小，优先级越高

QosPolicieDescription.description_zh: 五元组规则的描述信息

SourcePortRange.description_en:
The source port range. Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

Examples of the source port range format:

1/200: indicates ports 1 to 200.
80/80: indicates port 80.
-1/-1: indicates that ports are not restricted
SourcePortRange.description_zh:
源端口范围。

取值范围：-1或1~65535。

源端口范围格式例如：

1/200，表示端口范围1至200。
80/80，表示端口80。
-1/-1，表示不限制端口

StartTime.description_en: The start of the effective period for the 5-tuple rules. The time is displayed in Beijing time. Format: UTC+8
StartTime.description_zh: 五元组规则开始生效时间。时间显示为北京时间，格式为UTC时间+8小时
